claimType: post-hoc mechanism discovery; not confirmatory efficacy evidence
motivation: U1b/U2 established predictive metric uncertainty, while U3-v1 and U3b failed to establish robust TSDF geometry improvement. U3c measures whether uncertainty has enough cross-view surface-conflict leverage to move a fused TSDF zero crossing.

inputs.coordinateConvention: +X right, +Y down, +Z forward; camera-to-world in FARO coordinates
inputs.confidenceEncoding: uint8 values 0,128,255 interpreted as c/255 exactly as U3b engine execution

observationConstruction.voxelCentres: exact prepared dense-TSDF volume voxel centres
observationConstruction.projection: same nearest-pixel projection and depth admissibility rules as UncertaintyTsdfVolume
observationConstruction.surfaceActiveRule: at least two admissible observations and min(abs(normalizedSignedDistance_i)) <= 0.25
observationConstruction.rationale: surface-active is defined from per-view observations rather than an extracted mesh, avoiding selection by either reconstruction method while focusing on voxels near at least one observed surface

perVoxelMetrics.conflictStdNormalized: population standard deviation of normalized signed-distance observations
perVoxelMetrics.uncertaintyResidualSpearman: within-voxel Spearman correlation between predictiveSensorSigma_i and abs(d_i-median(d)); only defined with >=3 observations and nonconstant ranks

report: Spearman correlation across five scenes between U3b improvement and fractionConflictMixedConfidence
Spearman correlation across five scenes between U3b improvement and p95FusionLeverageMetres
Spearman correlation across five scenes between U3b improvement and medianUncertaintyResidualSpearman
crossSceneAnalysis.warning: n=5 and outcomes are already exposed; correlations are hypothesis-generating only

interpretationRules.lowOpportunity: If conflict-mixed-confidence voxels are rare and fusion leverage is usually much less than 0.25 voxel, conclude TSDF weighting has little mechanical opportunity to move geometry in this setup.
interpretationRules.misalignedUncertainty: If conflict exists but uncertaintyResidualSpearman is near zero or negative, conclude calibrated sensor uncertainty is not aligned with the per-voxel contradictory observations that TSDF fusion must resolve.
interpretationRules.latentOpportunity: If conflict-mixed-confidence voxels and leverage are substantial but geometry improvement remains heterogeneous, conclude simple weighted averaging is an insufficient decision rule and use U4 to alter representation/support/topology rather than retune scalar weights.
interpretationRules.noEfficacyClaim: U3c cannot rescue or overturn the negative U3/U3b confirmatory outcomes.
